title: Mira the Sea Turtle and the Glowing Garden
description: A teal sea turtle takes a shy little fish on a slow moonlit swim to a glowing coral garden, then brings her home to sleep.

Mira.role: Main character; a gentle sea turtle
Mira.color: Deep teal shell with one pale moon-spot on the side and a softer teal body
Mira.bodyShape: Smooth sea turtle with four flippers, not human arms or hands
Mira.face: Kind dark eyes and a small calm smile
Mira.accessories: No clothes, tools, or logos; the pale moon-spot is her only mark

Nori.role: Supporting character; a shy little fish
Nori.color: Little yellow body with soft cream fins
Nori.bodyShape: Tiny round fish, much smaller than Mira, with fins not arms
Nori.face: Large shy dark eyes and a tiny smile

settingBible.Moonlit Reef: A quiet blue reef, a soft anemone home, sandy naps, kelp ribbons, and a far coral garden that glows with tiny lights
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft underwater moonlight, one scene per page, calm blues and teals, and no readable text

continuityRules: Mira keeps the same deep teal shell, one pale moon-spot, kind dark eyes, and four flippers.
Nori stays a tiny yellow fish with cream fins and shy dark eyes, always smaller than Mira.
Neither has human-like arms or hands.
The swim is a slow visit, not a rescue or a repair.
Water stays clear and calm, from blue reef night to the glowing garden and back.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: The reef was blue and quiet as Mira woke from a sandy nap.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira wakes on pale sand in a blue quiet reef, her teal shell and moon-spot easy to see.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Mira's teal shell, one pale moon-spot, dark eyes, and flippers.

pages.text: Moonlight turned the coral silver, but the water stayed still.
pages.illustrationScene: Moonlight silvers the nearby coral while Mira floats in still blue water.
pages.continuityNotes: Still water. Silver coral. Mira unchanged.

pages.text: Nori, a little yellow fish, peeked from a soft anemone.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny yellow Nori peeks from a soft anemone while Mira waits nearby in the quiet reef.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Nori's yellow body, cream fins, and shy eyes. She is much smaller than Mira.

pages.text: Nori had never seen the far garden, so Mira offered a slow swim.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira turns gently toward the open water and Nori comes out to follow for a slow swim.
pages.continuityNotes: Offer is calm. No rush. Both designs locked.

pages.text: They passed a sleeping ray, flat as a blanket on the sand.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira and Nori pass a sleeping ray lying flat like a blanket on the sand.
pages.continuityNotes: Ray stays asleep. Sand is undisturbed.

pages.text: Mira kept her flippers gentle so the sand stayed still.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira moves her flippers slowly and the sand below stays smooth as Nori swims beside her shell.
pages.continuityNotes: Flippers only, no hands. Sand stays still.

pages.text: Seahorses nodded from a ribbon of kelp.
pages.illustrationScene: A few small seahorses nod from one kelp ribbon as Mira and Nori pass slowly.
pages.continuityNotes: Seahorses are calm background. Kelp is one ribbon.

pages.text: The water brightened, and tiny lights winked in the coral.
pages.illustrationScene: The water ahead brightens as tiny lights begin winking in distant coral, with Mira and Nori swimming toward them.
pages.continuityNotes: Lights are tiny and friendly, not a glare.

pages.text: They found the glowing garden, and Nori stayed close and safe.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira and Nori arrive in a coral garden full of soft glowing lights, with Nori close to Mira's shell.
pages.continuityNotes: Garden is the destination, not a fix. Nori stays close.

pages.text: Nori swam one small happy circle.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori swims one small happy circle among the glowing coral while Mira watches.
pages.continuityNotes: One small circle only. Mira waits.

pages.text: They floated and watched the lights pulse like easy breathing.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira and Nori float still while the garden lights pulse slowly like easy breathing.

pages.text: A far-off whale song rolled by, and they only listened.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira and Nori listen in the glowing garden as a far-off whale song moves through the water.
pages.continuityNotes: They listen only. No whale needs help. Whale may stay unseen.

pages.text: Mira turned toward the home rocks, with Nori close to her shell.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira turns back toward the home rocks and Nori swims close beside the moon-spot on her shell.
pages.continuityNotes: Moon-spot stays on the same side. Homeward is unhurried.

pages.text: Nori slipped back into the anemone, safe and sleepy.
pages.illustrationScene: Nori slips into the same soft anemone, sleepy, while Mira floats beside the home rocks.
pages.continuityNotes: Same anemone as page 3. Nori is safe and sleepy.

pages.text: Mira rested on the warm sand, so goodnight, glowing garden.
pages.illustrationScene: Mira rests on the warm sand by the home reef, eyes soft, with a far hint of the glowing garden.
pages.continuityNotes: Goodnight ending. Mira's shell, moon-spot, and flippers unchanged.
